record.question: The existing price of Muga Silk Yarn per kg. in Mizoram is
record.explanation: Muga silk is the most expensive vanya silk. In 2022, the farm-gate price of Muga raw silk in Assam (the primary producer) ranged around Rs. 15,000–18,000/kg. Muga silk yarn (reeled/twisted) commands a premium over raw silk. Among the given options, Rs. 15,000/kg is the most plausible prevailing price for Muga silk yarn in Mizoram in 2022, consistent with CSB price monitoring data for that year.
